zh-Hans.promotionalText: 每份 PDF 可单独选页，再合并排版并批量打印。每面支持 1–16 页，预览、撤销与导出均在本机完成。
zh-Hans.description:
PDF合并打印是一款轻量的原生 macOS PDF 阅读、合并与多页打印工具。把多份文件按顺序合在一起，在一张纸的每一面放置 3 页、5 页或任意 1–16 个 PDF 页面。适用于发票报销、办公文档、合同、作业、讲义、试卷和资料整理。

一次选择或拖入多份 PDF，即可组成连续页面队列。每份文件都可以保留全部页面，或输入 1,3,5-7 这样的原始页码选择要打印的页面；选中页面按文件顺序合并。应用按文件名顺序添加文件，你也可以拖动排序，继续添加或移除文件。无需先保存临时合并文件，即可查看原页、检查打印预览、批量打印或导出已经排版的 PDF。选择每面 1 页，也可将多份 PDF 按顺序输出到一个文件。

常用的排版不必重复设置。将每面页数、纸张、方向、排列、边距与边框保存为命名打印方案，下次直接套用；方案可重命名或删除。文件添加、移除和排序支持撤销与重做，清空列表后也能恢复。移除仅影响当前文件队列，不会删除 Mac 上的原文件。

主要功能：

- 每面放置 1–16 页，默认 3 页；常用 1–6 页一键选择
- 多份 PDF 自动合并页面顺序，连续排版、预览与批量打印
- 上下单列、左右单行或自动网格排列，支持 3 页、5 页等奇数页
- A4、A3、Letter 纸张，横向或纵向，边距与页面边框可选
- 按合并后的连续页码选择打印范围
- 每份 PDF 独立选择全部页面或指定页码，支持 1,3,5-7 等范围
- 命名保存多套打印方案，重启后仍可使用
- 添加、移除和排序支持 ⌘Z 撤销、⇧⌘Z 重做
- 原生文件列表支持拖动排序、键盘操作与右键菜单
- 文件列表可折叠，侧栏可调整宽度或隐藏，小窗口中设置可滚动
- 原 PDF 与打印预览切换，页面缩略图导航、缩放和适合窗口
- 调用 macOS 系统打印面板选择打印机与双面打印设置
- 导出已经排版的 PDF，保留 PDF 矢量内容
- 中英文界面跟随系统语言，支持 Apple 芯片与 Intel Mac

使用方法：

1. 点击“添加 PDF…”或将文件拖入窗口，一次添加一份或多份 PDF。
2. 在“文件”列表中确认顺序，拖动调整；误操作可用 ⌘Z 撤销。
3. 在“排版”中设置每面页数、纸张、方向和排列；边距、边框与页码范围位于“更多设置”。
4. 需要重复使用时，在“打印方案”中选择“存储当前设置…”。
5. 确认“打印预览”后，点击“打印…”或“导出 PDF…”。

应用已经完成多页排版，系统打印面板中的“布局”请保持每张 1 页。打印方案不包含文件、页码范围和系统打印机设置。

PDF 内容完全在本机处理，无需账号或网络连接，不上传文件，不收集用户数据。需要 macOS 13 或更高版本。
zh-Hans.keywords: PDF,三页一张,五页一张,选页,指定页码,批量,拼版,多页合一,页面布局,纸张排版,发票,合同,讲义,试卷,作业,文档,阅读器,预览,离线,排序,A4,A3,Letter,n-up,导出,奇数页
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
- 新增按文件选页：每份 PDF 可选择全部页面，或输入 1,3,5-7 等原始页码。
- 选中页面按文件顺序进入打印预览、打印和导出，原 PDF 保持完整不变。
- 选页、重排和删除支持撤销与重做；整体页码范围提示更清楚。
- 优化文件列表中的页数状态与中英文选页界面。
zh-Hans.reviewNotes:
版本 1.4.0（构建 17）。这是一款面向办公用户、学生和教师的原生 macOS PDF 合并与多页打印工具，可将多份本地 PDF 按顺序排版到每面 1–16 页，并为每份文件单独选择要打印的页面。

无需账号、登录凭据、订阅、App 内购买或网络连接。没有托管的用户生成内容、社交功能或外部内容服务。核心功能使用系统 AppKit、PDFKit 与 macOS 打印系统，不使用第三方 SDK、云后端、支付、认证或 AI 服务。所有 PDF 内容均在本机处理，不收集数据。

审核步骤：

1. 在 macOS 13 或更高版本的 Mac 上启动应用，点击工具栏“添加 PDF…”（⌘O）或空白页中的“添加 PDF…”。选择两份或更多可打印的本地 PDF；无需特殊样本，任意普通 PDF 均可。
2. 点击文件列表中某份 PDF 下方的页数状态，选择“指定页面”，输入 1,3,5-7 并应用；另一份 PDF 可保留全部页面或使用其他页码。确认预览中的页面按文件顺序连续排列。
3. 查看“打印预览”。默认每面 3 页；在“排版”中选择 5，或输入 1–16 范围内的其他值。整体页码范围是在每份文件选页结果之上的进一步筛选。
4. 在“文件”列表中拖动排序，或选中文件后使用 Option + 上下方向键。按 Delete 从队列移除文件，再用 ⌘Z 撤销、⇧⌘Z 重做；原文件不会被删除。可将文件全部移除后撤销恢复。
5. 在“排版 → 打印方案”中选择“存储当前设置…”，输入名称并存储。改变排版后选择已存方案，确认设置恢复。菜单还支持重命名和删除；方案重启后仍保留，不包含源文件、页码范围或系统打印机设置。
6. 展开“更多设置”，调整边距、边框或合并后的页码范围。文件列表可折叠；小窗口中可滚动侧栏查看下方设置。
7. 点击“打印…”（⌘P）打开系统打印面板。应用已经完成拼版，系统“布局”应保持每张 1 页。可在系统面板中选择打印机及其支持的双面选项，也可取消返回。点击“导出 PDF…”（⌘S）将排版结果保存到用户选择的位置。

首次同时选择多个文件时按文件名顺序添加；用户可随后调整顺序。应用不会在磁盘创建临时合并文件。功能在所有地区一致；界面根据系统语言使用简体中文或英语。应用不属于受监管行业，也不提供受保护的第三方内容。用户自行选择其本地 PDF。

en-US.promotionalText: Choose pages from each PDF, then merge, preview, print, or export. Use 1–16 pages per sheet with undo and local processing.
en-US.description:
PDF Merge & Print is a lightweight native macOS utility for reading, combining, and printing PDFs. Place 3 pages, 5 pages, or any value from 1–16 on each printed side. Organize invoices, office documents, contracts, worksheets, handouts, exams, and reference material in one workflow.

Select or drop multiple PDFs to build a continuous page queue. For each file, keep all pages or enter original page ranges such as 1,3,5-7; selected pages flow into the combined order. Files are added in filename order; drag to rearrange them, add more, or remove individual files. View the original pages, check the print preview, and print or export without saving a temporary merged file first. Choose one page per sheet to output multiple PDFs as one file.

Keep layouts you use often. Save pages per sheet, paper size, orientation, arrangement, margins, and borders as a named print preset, then apply it next time. Rename or delete presets as your needs change. Undo and redo file additions, removals, and reordering, even after clearing the queue. Removing a file from the queue never deletes the original from your Mac.

Features:

- Place 1–16 pages on each printed side, with 3 as the default and quick choices for 1–6
- Combine multiple PDFs into a continuous layout for preview and batch printing
- Arrange pages in a vertical column, horizontal row, or automatic grid, including odd counts such as 3 and 5
- Choose A4, A3, or Letter paper, portrait or landscape, margins, and page borders
- Select page ranges from the combined page order
- Select all or specific pages independently in each PDF, including ranges such as 1,3,5-7
- Save named print presets that remain available after restarting the app
- Undo file changes with Command-Z and redo with Shift-Command-Z
- Use a native file list with drag reordering, keyboard controls, and a context menu
- Collapse the file list, resize or hide the sidebar, and scroll settings in smaller windows
- Switch between Original PDF and Print Preview, navigate thumbnails, zoom, or fit to the window
- Use the native macOS print dialog for printer and supported duplex settings
- Export an imposed PDF while preserving vector content
- Use English or Simplified Chinese based on your system language, on Apple silicon or Intel Macs

Workflow:

1. Click Add PDFs… or drop one or more PDFs into the window.
2. Check the Files list and drag to reorder. Use Command-Z to undo a file change.
3. Set pages per sheet, paper, orientation, and arrangement in Layout. Find margins, borders, and page ranges in More Settings.
4. To reuse a layout, choose Save Current Settings… from the Print preset menu.
5. Check Print Preview, then choose Print… or Export PDF….

The app has already arranged your pages, so keep Pages per Sheet set to 1 in the system print dialog. Presets do not include files, page ranges, or system printer settings.

All PDF processing stays on your Mac. No account, network connection, file uploads, or data collection. Requires macOS 13 or later.
en-US.whatsNew:
- Choose pages independently from each PDF with original ranges such as 1,3,5-7.
- Selected pages flow in file order into print preview, printing, and export; originals stay unchanged.
- Undo and redo page selection, file reordering, and removal. Combined page ranges now explain their relationship to per-file selections.
- Refined the file list page-count status and the localized page-selection flow.
en-US.reviewNotes:
Version 1.4.0, build 17. This native macOS PDF merge and multiple-pages-per-sheet utility is for office users, students, and teachers. It arranges local PDFs in order, with 1–16 pages per printed side, and lets each file choose its own pages.

No account, login credentials, subscription, in-app purchase, or network connection is required. There is no hosted user-generated content, social functionality, or external content service. Core functionality uses Apple's AppKit, PDFKit, and macOS printing system. There are no third-party SDKs, cloud backends, payment providers, authentication services, or AI services. PDF content is processed locally and no data is collected.

Review steps:

1. Launch on a Mac running macOS 13 or later. Click Add PDFs… in the toolbar (Command-O) or Add PDFs… on the welcome screen. Choose at least two printable local PDFs. No special sample is required; any ordinary PDF documents can be used.
2. Click the page-count status under a PDF in the Files list, choose Selected Pages, enter 1,3,5-7, and apply. Keep all pages in another PDF or choose a different range. Confirm the preview follows file order.
3. Inspect Print Preview with the default 3 pages per sheet. Choose 5 in Layout, or enter another count from 1–16. The combined page range is an additional filter after per-file selection.
4. Drag files in the Files list to reorder, or select a file and use Option-Up/Down. Press Delete to remove a file from the queue, Command-Z to undo, and Shift-Command-Z to redo. Original files are not deleted. Removing all files can also be undone.
5. In Layout, open Print preset and choose Save Current Settings…. Enter a name and save. Change the layout, then choose the saved preset to restore it. The menu also supports Rename Preset… and Delete Preset…. Presets persist across app restarts and exclude files, page ranges, and system printer settings.
6. Expand More Settings to change margins, borders, or page ranges in the combined page order. The file list can be collapsed, and the sidebar scrolls to lower settings in a smaller window.
7. Click Print… (Command-P) to open the native print dialog. The pages are already composed, so keep the system Layout setting at 1 page per sheet. Choose a printer and its supported duplex options, or cancel to return. Click Export PDF… (Command-S) to save the composed PDF at a user-selected location.

Files selected together are initially added in filename order; users can then reorder them. The app does not create a temporary merged file on disk. Functionality is consistent across all regions; the interface uses English or Simplified Chinese according to the system language. The app does not operate in a regulated industry or supply protected third-party content. Users select their own local PDFs.
